data.one_liner: BlocProvider implementation with riverpod as alternative to provider.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BlocProvider implementation using riverpod as an alternative to provider, functioning similarly to StateNotifierProvider. It allows managing state using the BLoC pattern integrated with riverpod providers.
use_when: You want to use the BLoC pattern with Riverpod state management.
You need a StateNotifierProvider-like experience using Cubit or Bloc.
avoid_when: You prefer the standard flutter_bloc widget-based provider approach.
You are not using Riverpod in your application.
strengths: Supports conditional listening and state selection out of the box.
weaknesses: Adds another conceptual layer by combining two major state management libraries.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official and standard widget-based integration for the BLoC library.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Riverpod state management without mixing in BLoC semantics.
